desc.ian_image_library:title: Lead Mule
desc.ian_image_library:descr: Mule trains have been used historically in the US and other locations in the world to carry cargo, but are still used today for recreational back-country trips. Typically, the lead mule carries the rider and the pack mule bears the load.
